def to_dict(self) -> dict:
    result = {
        "name": StageName(self.name).value,
        "authority": _token(self.authority),
        "decision": _token(self.decision),
        "reason_code": _token(self.reason_code),
        "input_digest": _token(self.input_digest),
        "output_digest": _token(self.output_digest),
        "detail": {str(_token(key)): _clean(item) for key, item in dict(self.detail or {}).items()},
    }
    if (StageName(self.name) is StageName.CAPABILITY
            and type(self.authority) is str
            and self.authority == "operation-owners@1"):
        result["authority"] = "operation-owners@1"
        for key, item in dict(self.detail or {}).items():
            if (type(key) is str and key == "table_version"
                    and type(item) is str and item == "operation-owners@1"):
                result["detail"]["table_version"] = "operation-owners@1"
    return result
